slots.symbol: a short realistic video of a calm clinic room, a tablet on the desk glowing with a plain chat bubble shape beside a stethoscope, the doctor's chair empty

slots.script: And now, something lighter. Colombian streamer Westcol was rehearsing a dance with his robot live, when it smacked him on the back of the head instead.
